info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status API enables users to retrieve the current statuses of support tickets within the system. This API provides essential visibility into the progress and resolution of customer-reported issues, making it invaluable for support teams and customer service representatives. Typical consumers include technical support staff and customer service personnel who need real-time updates on ticket resolution. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their response strategies and improve customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their tickets in the system, providing real-time updates on the tickets' progress and state.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the status of tickets. Ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema for proper processing.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListSupportTicketsStatusRequest.description: The request body for getting the status of tickets.

ListSupportTicketsStatusResponse_204.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket status is successfully retrieved.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The ID for the result of the ticket processing.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The amount of time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the ticket status.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the ticket processing.

ListSupportTicketsStatusResponse_204.description: This schema represents the response for the GET operation to check the status of tickets.

Audit.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket was created automatically.

Audit.description: This schema contains the audit information related to the ticket processing.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
